```{=html}
<script>
// Filter jenis, tombol Summary/Cite, dan salin sitasi
document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
  var f = e.target.closest(".pub-filter .topic-filter-btn");
  if (f) {
    var c = f.dataset.cat;
    document.querySelectorAll(".pub-filter .topic-filter-btn").forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle("active", b === f); });
    document.querySelectorAll(".pub-item").forEach(function (li) { li.hidden = c !== "all" && li.dataset.cat !== c; });
    document.querySelectorAll(".pub-year").forEach(function (sec) { sec.hidden = !sec.querySelector(".pub-item:not([hidden])"); });
    return;
  }
  var t = e.target.closest(".pub-btn[data-toggle]");
  if (t) {
    var panel = document.getElementById(t.dataset.toggle);
    var open = panel.hidden;
    panel.hidden = !open;
    t.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
    t.classList.toggle("active", open);
    return;
  }
  var c2 = e.target.closest(".pub-copy");
  if (c2) {
    var txt = document.getElementById(c2.dataset.copy).textContent;
    var done = function () { var old = c2.innerHTML; c2.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check2"></i> Copied'; setTimeout(function () { c2.innerHTML = old; }, 1500); };
    if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(done, done); else done();
  }
});
</script>
```
